title: Backups
description: Full backups of the database and all stored files (images, invoices, tickets, bank statements). Backups are encrypted and kept in their own storage bucket; an external S3 target is optional.
keyNote: Archives are encrypted with the key ring of this installation (key "{keyId}"). To restore a backup on another server, that server needs the same APP_ENCRYPTION_KEYS – keep a copy of them outside this system.

maintenance.title: Maintenance in progress
maintenance.text: The system is being restored from a backup and is briefly unavailable. This page reloads automatically.

steps.RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: Restore incomplete – the system stays in maintenance mode

status.title: Current operation
status.stale: No progress report for several minutes – the worker may have stopped. A new operation can be started once the system reports idle.
status.restoreRunning: A restore is running. The shop is in maintenance mode and the admin area may be unavailable for a moment. You may be signed out afterwards if your session is not part of the restored data.

steps.IMPORT_FAILED: The uploaded file is not a valid backup
steps.REJECTED_MIGRATION_NEWER: Rejected: the backup was made by a newer version of the software
steps.REJECTED_KEY_UNKNOWN: Rejected: the encryption key of this backup is not available here
steps.REJECTED_ARCHIVE_INVALID: Rejected: the archive is damaged or was modified
steps.REJECTED_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: Rejected: the checksum does not match

verifyDetail.ARCHIVE_MISMATCH: The archive does not match its description.
verifyDetail.ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH: The test restore has different record counts than the backup.
verifyDetail.CREATEDB_MISSING: Checksum and decryption are fine, but the database user may not create databases, so no test restore was possible.
verifyDetail.KEY_UNKNOWN: The encryption key of this backup is not available.
verifyDetail.CORRUPT: The backup is damaged or was modified.

restore.title: Restore this backup?
restore.description: The database and all files are replaced by the state of {date}. A safety backup of the current state is created first; the shop is unavailable while the restore runs.
restore.lossTitle: Created after this backup and lost by the restore:
restore.lossNone: Nothing was created in the live system after this backup.
restore.gobd: Invoice and order numbers are never reused: the number counters keep the higher live values, so gaps may appear in the number sequence.
restore.acknowledge: I understand that data created after the backup is lost and that the system is unavailable during the restore.
restore.twoFactorSetup: Restoring requires two-factor authentication, but your account has none. Set up an authenticator app first.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this backup?
deleteConfirm.description: The backup is removed from this server and from the external target. This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.external: Also delete the copy on the external target

upload.hint: Restore a backup from another server or from the external target: upload the .tixbak file. It is checked completely before it appears in the list. Restoring requires the same encryption keys.
upload.accepted: Upload received – the file is being checked.
upload.notABackup: This file is not a backup archive.

settings.title: Schedule, retention and external copy
settings.description: Times use the shop time zone ({timeZone}).
settings.scheduleHint: A backup missed by more than six hours (e.g. the system was down) is skipped until the next slot.
settings.keepScheduledHint: Older scheduled backups are deleted, on the external target too. Manual backups are kept until you delete them.
settings.alertEmail: Alert e-mail for failed scheduled backups
settings.alertEmailHint: Sent through the configured mail server; failures also appear on the dashboard.

external.title: External S3 copy
external.enabled: Upload every backup to an external S3-compatible target
external.forcePathStyle: Path-style addressing (needed for MinIO and many providers)
external.replaceHint: Leave empty to keep the stored keys.
external.enterHint: Both keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

settings.manualMaxAgeDays: Delete manual and safety backups after (days)
settings.manualMaxAgeDaysHint: 0 = keep until deleted by hand. Backups contain personal data: a limit helps with erasure requests (GDPR Art. 17). The newest verified backup is never deleted. Erasures are replayed after a restore.
settings.allowPrivateNetwork: Allow endpoints in private networks (e.g. a MinIO on your LAN)
settings.credentialsChangeHint: Changing endpoint or bucket requires entering the keys again.

feedback.connectionOk: Connection works: a test file was written, read and deleted.
feedback.busy: Another backup operation is running. Please wait until it has finished.
feedback.twoFactorRequired: Enter the code of your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
feedback.acknowledge: Please confirm that you understand the consequences.
feedback.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
feedback.connectionIncomplete: Please enter endpoint, bucket and both access keys first.
feedback.endpointNotAllowed: This endpoint is not allowed: use https and a public address (or enable the matching option below).
feedback.protected: The newest verified backup cannot be deleted.
feedback.twoFactorSetupRequired: Restoring requires two-factor authentication. Set it up in your account first.

incomplete.title: Restore incomplete – the system stays in maintenance mode
incomplete.text: The database was replaced but the restore did not finish (step: {step}). Run the restore again, or restore the safety backup that was taken before it.
